# <!--name-->docs-builder/preview/cleanup<!--/name-->
<!--description-->
Delete GitHub deployments and S3 preview objects for a closed PR
<!--/description-->

## Inputs
<!--inputs-->
| Name                   | Description                                      | Required | Default                                |
|------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|----------|----------------------------------------|
| `pr-number`            | Pull request number                              | `true`   | ` `                                    |
| `environment`          | GitHub deployment environment name               | `false`  | `docs-preview`                         |
| `s3-bucket-path`       | S3 bucket path prefix (without trailing /pull/N) | `false`  | `s3://elastic-docs-v3-website-preview` |
| `aws-role-name-prefix` | AWS IAM role name prefix for OIDC auth           | `false`  | `elastic-docs-v3-preview-`             |
<!--/inputs-->
